about: Shared table for release validation (schema/README.md, 'Rules'). Each case edits a copy of the fixture release (fixtures/public) and names the exact set of issue codes both validators must report; an empty set means the edited release is still valid. Run by tests/v2/test_release.py and packages/core/src/release/release.test.ts. Steps: set / delete at a JSON path in a file; remove_file; move_file; copy_file; raw (replace a file's bytes with a text's); rename_release (the directory name); remove_bulk (every file under downloads/: for a case about a Release that may have none, an earlier contract or a local profile). After the steps the harness refreshes the sha256 of every manifest row whose file still exists (and its vintages_sha256, when the row has one and the vintage file exists), unless the case says rehash: false.
